profile.name: 超声波测距传感器
profile.description: 一种基于 HC-SR04 一类模块的超声波距离传感器，通过发射超声脉冲并测量回波返回时间来估算目标距离。常用于实验室与教学场景中的接近检测、障碍物探测、液位估计、位置触发和机器人避障等应用，通常通过 GPIO 的触发与回波引脚连接控制。
profile.description_en: An ultrasonic distance sensor of the HC-SR04 class that estimates target distance by emitting ultrasonic pulses and timing the returning echo. It is commonly used in lab and teaching setups for proximity sensing, obstacle detection, level estimation, position-based triggering, and basic robotics, typically via GPIO trigger and echo connections.
